description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_Linkify, which extends HTMLPurifier_Injector and implements functionality to convert URLs within text tokens into clickable HTML links by injecting appropriate anchor tags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_Linkify
classes.description: An injector class that finds URL-like text in tokens and wraps them with HTML anchor tags to create clickable links.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Converts URL-like text within a token into clickable links by injecting anchor tags, using regex to identify URLs.
